description:
Use this when the user asks for quarter-on-quarter or year-on-year growth and margin trends of an Indian company period by period.

Returns one row per period, newest first, with revenue, net profit, EPS and margins, the change from the period before and from the same period a year earlier, and segment figures, plus growth rates across the periods shown. `period_type` is "quarterly" (default) or "annual"; `limit` is 1 to 20 (default 8); `statement_type` is "auto" (default), "consolidated" or "standalone". A quarter reported only as a year-to-date figure is left out, and a change is empty when the period it compares with is missing. It has no balance sheet and no trailing-twelve-month figures: use get_financials for those.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
